annotations.title: Give a user an app role

description: Give an app user a business role (a user can hold several). Takes the userId from list_app_users and a role key from list_app_roles. expiresAt makes the grant temporary. Granting the same pair again changes only expiresAt. This is for personal exceptions; for a whole team prefer set_policy_identity, which reads the roles from an employees board. Requires organization owner or admin.

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 date-time when the grant ends. Omit for no end

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

roleKey.description: Role key: a short stable id such as "manager" or "agent" (what policies name). Built-in keys: "*" (every signed-in user of the app) and "public" (anonymous visitors); they need no definition and no grant

userId.description: The user's id (userId from list_app_users), a UUID

name: grant_app_role
